description: This Java class implements a custom constraint validator for validating local date strings based on specified format and locale, used within the Fineract project.

classes.name: LocalDateValidator
classes.description: A constraint validator class for validating date strings against a specified format and locale.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with annotation parameters specifying date, format, and locale fields.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the object by extracting date, format, and locale fields and attempting to parse the date string.

methods.name: toLocalDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a LocalDate object using the specified format and locale.
